tools.name: update_task_status
tools.description: Updates the status of a task in the project database and records the change time on the task row.

params.name: task_id
params.description: ID of the task to update

params.name: status
params.description: New status such as todo, in_progress, review, or done

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("project-tasks")
DB_PATH = "projects.db"


@dataclass
class StatusUpdateResult:
    task_id: int
    status: str
    updated: bool


@mcp.tool()
def update_task_status(task_id: int, status: str) -> StatusUpdateResult:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE tasks SET status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (status, now, task_id),
        )
        conn.commit()
        return StatusUpdateResult(task_id, status, cur.rowcount > 0)
    finally:
        conn.close()
